title: HARVEST GUESTBOOK
description: Festival harvests now create a small guestbook with neighbor notes, pet paw stamps, crop photos, and one shareable page for the year's best absurd vegetable.

title: PRIVATE MEMORY GARDEN
description: Homes can now grow a quiet memory garden where old gifts, companion visits, and finished projects become small flowers only the household can name.
consequence: The garden keeps its voice down.

title: MASCOT REACTION FRAMES
description: End screens now replace squad snapshots with seasonal mascot reactions, branded victory poses, and sticker-ready frames built for instant sharing.

title: ANONYMOUS FESTIVAL CROWD
description: Town festivals now fill empty spaces with rotating crowd NPCs, generic cheers, and temporary guild flags instead of familiar villagers with old grudges.
